title: Mockingjay
author: Suzanne Collins
summary: Katniss becomes the face of an open rebellion against the Capitol, leading a war that tests every loyalty she has and leaves her to wonder who is really using her.
readIf: you've followed the trilogy and want the conclusion, which is bleak and unsentimental about war.
skipIf: you want a triumphant ending or a lot of arena action.

pairings.reason: Another story of a rebellion told from the inside, brutal and fast-moving.
A cold, honest science fiction look at what war does to soldiers.
Another young adult dystopian with two leads, a fractured regime and a high-pace plot.
